brief.t: START HERE: Ask Evelyn and Ron to replace the dirty cleaning cloths with clean approved supplies before equipment is cleaned again.

Send internally: Evelyn and Ron, please stop using the dirty cloths, confirm clean approved supplies are physically available, and check whether any equipment or batches need review before the next run.

New supplier orders are not usable-stock proof. Send internally: Michael and Evelyn, please confirm the sample approval and whether tomorrow’s Men’s Moisturizer run is actually scheduled, then check usable stock and incoming orders with me today.

ACT NOW 3: Verify Oreka’s finished-sample delivery plan. Nadia’s response task is15days overdue, with Canada arrival needed beforeNovember1. Nikkie clarified October28 that done was an assumption because the task disappeared, not completion proof. Mibelle says raw ingredient scheduled FedExGround October28,tracking879370662656; this does not establish carrier acceptance, arrival or finished-sample shipment. Michael’s huddle reports similarly named Aurica samples awaiting fulfillment addresses; identity must be checked. Send internally: Michael and Steve, please confirm Oreka’s finished samples, QC release, exact shipping addresses and delivery date today so we can give Nadia a confirmed answer before her Canada window closes.
